records.text: Citing an article, Owens said UVU announced a bomb simulation at the UCCU Center on June 17 from 10:30 a.m. to 12:30 p.m., with 50 people wearing theater makeup and fake injuries to enhance realism.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: It says police cars, fire crews, SWAT units, ambulances and a life flight helicopter flocked to Utah Valley University on Tuesday, but it was just a drill. ... University officials gave notice that a bomb simulation was going to take place at the campus at the UCCU Center on June 17th from 10.30 a.m. to 12.30 p.m. Officials said there would be 50 people with theater makeup and fake injuries to enhance the realism of the simulation.
